replication.target_description: EmpaToM compassion: age-group independent comparison of mean concern ratings across conditions.

n.location: Methods: Participants (final sample); Data analysis (outcome-specific outliers)
n.quote: The final sample comprised 42 younger (21 females, age range = 18–30, M = 24.00, s.d. = 3.20) and 44 older (22 females, age range = 65–77, M = 69.50, s.d. = 3.74) individuals. ... Furthermore, we excluded three participants (OA = 1, YA = 2) from the analysis of empathy and one participant (YA = 1) from the analysis of compassion due to them being extreme outliers (greater than 3 s.d.) on the valence ratings or concern rating, respectively.
n.sample_role: Participants in compassion age-group analysis; 41 younger and 44 older.
n.exclusions: 15 excluded during/after session before final groups of 42 younger/44 older. Compassion excludes YA = 1 extreme outlier (>3 s.d.). Two below-chance participants retained. Technical/button-box and sleep trials excluded and scores proportionally adjusted.
